answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our economy uses game-theoretic multi-agent auditing: random audit swarms inspect suspect clusters, slashing bonded stake upon fraud. Verifiers test network topology via min-cut bottlenecks; isolating a Sybil cluster in an artificial lagoon against honest traffic incurs a superlinear attacker cost. Dense coordination must hold firm like a walnut shell against a gale of forged identities.
